d:
What a good comic! I came multiple times reading this. peak ;)
Its a story about a clumsy gentle uncle who goes to a tribal village for a “manhood ritual”, based on a Japanese reality show - The Quest (世界の果てまでイッテQ!) - where the comedians are put in comical situations. super funny.

I'll leave the link to the comic here, please support the artists!
